subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should Control UI channel viewing stop at the current Sessions-page Group by Channel behavior, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel conversation timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main covers row-level channel grouping, but a merged transcript/timeline crosses UX, privacy, session-state, and routing boundaries that need maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Scope Conversation Toggle
options.body: Keep this issue open and define separated channel tabs, merged timeline semantics, and routing/privacy boundaries before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close or narrow this issue if maintainers decide Group by Channel plus per-session navigation is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining behavior under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if one broader sessions workspace should own channel views too.

recommendation.title: Scope Conversation Toggle
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define separated channel tabs, merged timeline semantics, and routing/privacy boundaries before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current implementation and public docs update came through his recent Sessions-page grouping work.
